name: Trades and home services
description: Practical two-page site for a plumber, electrician or builder. Leads with the phone number and call-out rates.

content.heading: Emergency plumbing, seven days a week
content.subheading: Usually with you inside two hours. Fixed call-out charge, quoted before we start.

content.heading: What we handle
content.feature1Text: Traced, isolated and repaired, including behind tiles and under floors.
content.feature2Text: Servicing, repairs and replacements, all makes.
content.feature3Text: Full installations, or just swapping the one thing that has failed.

content.heading: Recent jobs
content.quote1: Burst pipe at 11pm on a Sunday. Here in ninety minutes, sorted by one.
content.quote2: Quoted half what the first firm wanted and explained why.
content.quote3: Cleaned up properly afterwards, which is rarer than it should be.

content.heading: Water coming through the ceiling?
content.subheading: Turn the stopcock off and call. We will talk you through it until we arrive.

content.heading: Get in touch
content.subheading: Call for anything urgent. Email for quotes.

content.heading: Call, or send the details
content.intro: For emergencies, phone. For quotes, send a photo of the problem and we will come back the same day.
content.hours: Mon to Sat 8am to 6pm, emergencies any time

content.heading: Before you call
content.a1: Within two hours for emergencies in the city, usually sooner outside rush hour.
content.a2: No. Quotes for planned work are free and in writing.
content.a3: Fully insured and happy to show the certificate before starting.
content.a4: Twelve months on labour, and whatever the manufacturer gives on parts.
